title: An Extensible Software Transport Layer for GPU Networking
authors: Yang Zhou; Zhongjie Chen; Ziming Mao; ChonLam Lao; Shuo Yang; Pravein Govindan Kannan; Jiaqi Gao; Yilong Zhao; Yongji Wu; Kaichao You; Fengyuan Ren; Zhiying Xu; Costin Raiciu; Ion Stoica
affiliations: UC Berkeley, UC Davis, Tsinghua University, Harvard University, IBM Research, Amazon Web Services, University Pollitehnica of Bucharest, Broadcom

problem_statement.en: Existing RDMA NIC hardware transport layers are difficult to evolve, leading to performance bottlenecks such as flow collisions, poor congestion control for ML workloads, and inefficient loss recovery.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 RDMA NIC 硬體傳輸層難以演進，導致流量碰撞、ML 工作負載的壅塞控制不佳，以及低效率的封包遺失恢復等效能瓶頸。

key_innovation.en: UCCL, an extensible software transport layer that decouples the data and control paths of RDMA NICs, allowing transport logic (congestion control, multipathing, loss recovery) to be implemented and updated in user-space CPU code.
key_innovation.zh: UCCL 是一套可擴展的軟體傳輸層，將 RDMA NIC 的資料路徑與控制路徑解耦，使壅塞控制、多路徑、封包遺失恢復等傳輸邏輯得以在使用者空間的 CPU 程式碼中實作與更新。

baselines_compared: NVIDIA NCCL built-in RDMA, AWS NCCL-EFA plugin, Broadcom Thor-2 RDMA transport

key_improvements.en: Up to 4.5x higher throughput for ML collectives, 4.9x better message tail latency for network incast, and significant performance gains in distributed training and MoE serving.
key_improvements.zh: ML 集合通訊吞吐量最高提升 4.5x，網路 incast 下訊息尾端延遲改善 4.9x，並在分散式訓練與 MoE serving 中取得顯著效能提升。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Model Training, MoE Serving, Allreduce, Allgather, Reduce-Scatter
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100-80G, NVIDIA A100-40G, AMD MI300X-192G
network_hw: NVIDIA ConnectX-7 400G, Broadcom Thor-2 400G, AWS EFA 100G
transport_and_interconnect: RDMA, RoCEv2, InfiniBand, UC, RC, UD, SRD, AF_XDP
